name: Kujirai Tasuku
source: The protagonist. He makes a living delivering newspapers in the morning and working at a toy store in the afternoon. Upon meeting Nicole on the island he lives on, he becomes her apprentice as Santa Claus. He's good with people, diligent and is the type to take on the burdens of other people to help them. He likes children, and his personality allows him him to get along well with them.
